description: Defines a custom layout class 'CheckableFrameLayout' that extends FrameLayout and implements the Checkable interface. It allows a frame to be toggled between checked and unchecked states, changing its background color accordingly.

classes.name: CheckableFrameLayout
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout that implements Checkable, allowing it to be toggled between checked and unchecked states with visual indication.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Sets the checked state and updates the background color accordingly.
